drop_ship_time_invalid.message: When the supplier shipped is not a valid time.

drop_ship_time_future.message: When the supplier shipped cannot lie in the future.

drop_ship_promise_required.message: Drop shipping is read for a customer or supplier delivery.

drop_ship_fields_invalid.message: Name the supplier delivery and the quantity the supplier shipped.

drop_ship_unresolved.message: A drop shipment of this supplier delivery is still being recorded.

drop_ship_purchase_not_to_customer.message: The purchase order does not ship to this customer. A drop-ship purchase order names the customer as where the goods go.

party_merge_parties_required.message: Name the duplicate business partner and the one it is merged into.

party_merge_reason_required.message: Say why the two business partners are one.

party_merge_reason_too_long.message: The reason is at most 500 characters.

party_merge_same_party.message: A business partner cannot be merged into itself.

party_merge_already_merged.message: {party} is already merged into {survivor}; use that business partner instead.

party_merge_survivor_inactive.message: {party} is inactive; merge into an active business partner.

party_merge_company_party.message: The company's own business partner is never merged.

party_merge_roles_missing.message: {party} lacks the role {roles} the duplicate has; give it that role first.

party_merge_hold_open.message: {party} has an open delivery hold; release it before merging.

revision_beyond_received.message: A received line can be raised only up to what was received and kept.

movement_beyond_order_receipt_only.message: Only a receipt against a purchase line can bring in more than the line expects.

misdelivery_commitment_both.message: A wrong item names the line it was meant for, not a line it fulfils.

misdelivery_movement_type.message: Wrong goods for this line move only as: {allowed}.

misdelivery_same_item.message: This is the item the line asks for, or one it accepted; record it against the line.

misdelivery_back_exceeds_out.message: Only {out} of this item went the wrong way for this line.

substitute_purchase_only.message: A substitute is accepted for a purchase line only.

substitute_line_cancelled.message: This purchase line is cancelled; it accepts no substitute.

substitute_same_item.message: This is the item the line already orders.

substitute_item_not_stocked.message: A substitute must be a stocked item.

substitute_unit_differs.message: The substitute is counted in {substitute}, the ordered item in {ordered}.

substitute_reason_required.message: Say why the substitute is accepted.

substitute_already_accepted.message: This item is already accepted for the line.

substitute_fields_invalid.message: Name the purchase line, the substitute item and the reason.

advice_supplier_delivery_only.message: Advised quantities belong to an inbound supplier delivery.

advice_lines_invalid.message: Each advised line names a purchase line and a quantity.

advice_line_not_this_supplier.message: An advised line must be an open purchase line of this supplier.

advice_line_repeated.message: A purchase line is advised once per notice.

advice_quantity_invalid.message: An advised quantity is positive, with at most four decimals.

shipment_receive_into_mismatch.message: Goods are received only into an announced inbound shipment of the same supplier and purpose.

shipment_receive_into_fields.message: The announced shipment already says how it travels; leave carrier and tracking out.

external_stock_quantity_invalid.message: A stated stock quantity is zero or more, with at most four decimals.

external_stock_time_invalid.message: When the stock was there is not a valid time.

external_stock_time_future.message: A stated stock level cannot lie in the future.

external_stock_item_not_stocked.message: Only a stocked item has stock to state.

external_stock_location_not_stock.message: The location is unknown, inactive or holds no stock.

external_stock_lines_required.message: Name at least one item, location and quantity.

external_stock_fields_invalid.message: State lines with an item, a location, a quantity and optionally when, plus optionally who reported it and a note.

external_stock_line_repeated.message: An item and location are stated twice for the same time.

external_stock_reporter_not_found.message: The business partner who reported the stock was not found.

email_chunk_invalid.message: Supply a valid, nonempty base64 chunk of at most one MiB.

email_file_limit_exceeded.message: The email file exceeds the configured upload limit.

email_file_checksum_mismatch.message: The supplied email file checksum does not match the stored contents.

email_attachment_required.message: Every outgoing attachment must have stored file contents.

email_recipients_required.message: An outgoing email needs at least one recipient.

email_fingerprint_mismatch.message: The email payload does not match the approved version.

email_decision_required.message: An explicitly approved email proposal is required before dispatch.

email_dispatch_already_claimed.message: This email dispatch has already been claimed. Reconcile it before proposing another send.

email_dispatch_reconcile_required.message: This dispatch already has execution evidence. Read and reconcile its history; do not send again.

email_executor_mismatch.message: Only the authenticated executor that claimed this dispatch may report its outcome.
